doc: terrain_relief_v1's output (design/terrain.md): the ground as hexbound columns of spans (design/import.hexbound.world.md), its water, roads, rivers, and bridges, the navigation mesh with its report, the boundary's hull, and the plotter's nature ground.

fields.name: corners
fields.doc: The shape's corners, metres (x, the side's height, z), counterclockwise as seen from above.

fields.name: side_lines
fields.doc: The sides as drawn (wobbled), segment pairs, metres.

fields.name: side_of_line
fields.doc: Each side segment's side.

fields.name: side_edges
fields.doc: Each side's edge (1 ledge to 7 marsh).

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: The terrain's cells, as q, r pairs.

fields.name: span_first
fields.doc: Each cell's first span; a cell's spans run to the next cell's first (one more entry than cells).

fields.name: span_lo
fields.doc: Each span's bottom, 1/8 m units.

fields.name: span_hi
fields.doc: Each span's top, 1/8 m units.

fields.name: span_material
fields.doc: Each span's material: 0 grass, 1 dirt, 2 sand, 3 snow, 4 cobble, 5 rock.

fields.name: water
fields.doc: Each cell's water level, 1/8 m units (-32768: dry).

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Each cell's flags: 1 on the edge, 2 road, 4 lane, 8 river, 16 lake, 32 bridge, 64 flat, 128 an opening's cell, 256 cave.

fields.name: road_cells
fields.doc: The roads, cells as q, r pairs, road after road.

fields.name: road_counts
fields.doc: How many cells each road has.

fields.name: river_cells
fields.doc: The rivers, cells as q, r pairs from inlet to outlet, river after river.

fields.name: river_counts
fields.doc: How many cells each river has.

fields.name: bridges
fields.doc: The bridges and their mounts.

fields.name: opening_cells
fields.doc: Each opening's cell on the edge, as q, r pairs, in the shape's order.

fields.name: nav_vertices
fields.doc: The navigation mesh's vertices, metres (each walkable top's hexagon).

fields.name: nav_polys
fields.doc: Its polygons' vertex indices, six each.

fields.name: nav_cells
fields.doc: Each polygon's cell (an index into cells).

fields.name: nav_links
fields.doc: Polygons a walker crosses between, as pairs: where an edge fuses or steps no more than 0.5 m, and over bridges.

fields.name: hull
fields.doc: The ring outside the shape for a boundary: each cell with its side's edge, height, and rise, and the openings that leave through it.

fields.name: nature
fields.doc: The open land for a plotter: heights, moisture, and ground; not on roads, water, or bridges.

fields.name: openings_unreached
fields.doc: Road openings some other road opening doesn't reach on foot (must be 0).

fields.name: flats_unreached
fields.doc: Flats a road opening doesn't reach (must be 0).

fields.name: longest_route_m
fields.doc: The longest walk between two road openings, metres.

fields.name: steepest_grade
fields.doc: The steepest step along a road, rise over run.

fields.name: flat_error_m
fields.doc: The farthest a flat's ground strays from its level, metres.

fields.name: cliff_m
fields.doc: Metres of cliff (edges that don't fuse).

fields.name: caves
fields.doc: Cells with an overhang or cave.

fields.name: bridge_count
fields.doc: Bridges.

fields.name: note
fields.doc: Why the plan fell short, if it did.
